paper: Alpha-GPT 2.0: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Quantitative Investment
headline_strategy: Human-in-the-loop quantitative-research workflow in which Alpha Mining, Alpha Modeling, and Alpha Analysis agents collaborate through tools and memory to generate, model, and assess alphas
paper_state: four-page Draft. Work in progress with no empirical experiment, displayed numeric result, plotted return series, final generated alpha, or portfolio rule
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable as a monthly U.S./JKP trading strategy from the authoritative paper and source
missing_headline_objects: an implemented Alpha Mining, Alpha Modeling, or Alpha Analysis agent
the agents' system-of-procedure prompts and model configuration
memory contents, retrieval state, and financial knowledge graph
a generated alpha set or selected final alpha
a causal score-to-position or portfolio construction rule
any native evaluation, return path, checkpoint, trace, or output
source_boundaries: The authoritative main document renders no experiment and explicitly identifies itself as work in progress.
Unused Alpha-GPT 1 experiment, table, UI, and architecture files bundled in the 2.0 source archive are not imported by main.tex and are not Alpha-GPT 2.0 evidence.
Ten repository searches found no author-linked implementation or data.
The unaffiliated parthmodi152/alpha-gpt project stops after LLM code generation and contains no genetic programming, backtest, market-data, or paper-result node.

rejected_substitutes.reason: Those expressions belong to a different paper/version and the inactive files bundled with 2.0 are not rendered evidence for the proposed three-agent workflow.
It is a later paper-inspired work in progress without the central modeling, evaluation, or backtest stages and has no author provenance.

rejected_substitutes.route: Implement three generic LLM prompts and a JKP factor search
rejected_substitutes.reason: The paper does not specify the SOP prompts, tools, memories, model zoo, search policy, final alpha, or portfolio; doing so would design a new system.

rejected_substitutes.route: Assign zero returns or a generic JKP characteristic
rejected_substitutes.reason: Absence of an executable strategy is not a cash strategy and a generic factor would not preserve the paper's human-in-the-loop agent mechanism.

result_policy: No monthly return is fabricated. This closure means the paper proposes an architecture but supplies no empirical or executable trading object; it does not establish that the proposed system would succeed or fail.
